title: SkyCeleste
description:
SkyCeleste is a QoL mod (later for Hypixel Skyblock) and fully complying with all Hypixel and Minecraft rules, ensuring fair play and compatibility.

The UI Buttons change with your texture packs! Cool!
body:
**What it adds:**
Fullbright for consistently clear visibility in all environments, making dark areas and nighttime much easier to navigate. A flexible Zoom feature gives you better precision and control, letting you focus in on distant details or fine elements with ease.

_Alongside these features_, the mod is designed to feel seamless and responsive, improving overall clarity and usability while you play. Everything works together to create a smoother, more polished experience, with additional updates and enhancements planned for the future.
